name: Lift by dimension
caveat: Bookers per value are distinct counts per leaf; sums across leaves are an upper bound.
explain: Per dimension value, the arm's net incremental bookings per participating day minus control's, each side weighted by its share of participants (participants_arm / participants_total); positive lift is green, negative red, and a two-proportion Z-test on conversion decides whether it clears the `confidence_bar`.
